name: StatusPilatus 0.5.0
body:
- New about page
- New battery page
- Fresh layout using materialize
- Some other fixes

name: StatusPilatus 0.4.0
body:
- Layout changes. All pages use the same layout
- On the network tab you can now check if you are connected to the internet and ping ip addresses
- On the cpu tab more information is shown
- You can now view your memory slots
- Processes are now also viewable

name: StatusPilatus 0.3.0
body:
- Improved OS and Storage tab
- Updated dependencies, including ProgListr, for better program detection
- Other small fixes

name: StatusPilatus 0.2.0
body:
- Program refresh and loading improved
- Small refactor and bug fixes
